name: age
source: Typical age of melanoma ICI cohorts (median ~60-62)

name: sex
source: Male share in melanoma ICI trials (~60-65%)

name: menopausal_status
description: Menopausal status (women only; blank for men by design)
signal: Sets LH/FSH/estradiol reference ranges

name: regimen
signal: Effect modifier: sets gland-damage rates (CTLA-4/combination raise pituitary damage)
source: Assumed MSK survivor mix (adjuvant PD-1 common; combination for stage IV)

name: stage_at_diagnosis
signal: Stage IV raises distress and brain metastases

name: months_since_therapy_end
description: Months from last ICI dose to index visit

name: irae_thyroiditis
signal: ~92% of primary hypothyroid patients; ~4% of others (resolved)
source: Barroso-Sousa 2018 JAMA Oncol (endocrine irAE meta-analysis); Faje 2019 Eur J Endocrinol (hypophysitis PD-1 vs ipilimumab); Patrinely 2021 JAMA Oncol (chronic irAEs after adjuvant PD-1)

name: irae_hypophysitis
signal: ~95% of hypophysitis patients
source: Barroso-Sousa 2018 JAMA Oncol (endocrine irAE meta-analysis); Faje 2019 Eur J Endocrinol (hypophysitis PD-1 vs ipilimumab); Patrinely 2021 JAMA Oncol (chronic irAEs after adjuvant PD-1)

name: irae_adrenalitis
signal: ~90% of primary adrenal insufficiency
source: Barroso-Sousa 2018 JAMA Oncol (endocrine irAE meta-analysis); Faje 2019 Eur J Endocrinol (hypophysitis PD-1 vs ipilimumab); Patrinely 2021 JAMA Oncol (chronic irAEs after adjuvant PD-1)

name: irae_colitis
signal: Raises chance of chronic inflammation

name: irae_arthritis
signal: Strongest driver of chronic inflammation
source: Braaten 2020 Ann Rheum Dis (persistent ICI arthritis)

name: irae_max_grade
description: Highest CTCAE grade of any irAE (0 = none)

name: brain_mets
signal: Competing cause of cognitive impairment

name: brain_radiation
signal: Lowers cognitive scores whatever the cause (SRS -0.4 SD, WBRT -1.0 SD)

name: prednisone_equiv_mg_day
signal: >=5 mg suppresses cortisol/ACTH, raises ANC, lowers ALC/eosinophils, LH, testosterone, CRP, IL-6
source: Beuschlein 2024 Eur J Endocrinol (glucocorticoid-induced adrenal insufficiency)

name: hydrocortisone_mg_day
signal: Measured cortisol then reflects dose and timing, not the gland
source: Bornstein 2016 J Clin Endocrinol Metab (adrenal insufficiency guideline)

name: levothyroxine_mcg_day
signal: TSH then reflects the prescription, not the gland

name: sex_hormone_replacement
signal: Masks gonadal deficiency; suppresses LH/FSH

name: tsh
signal: Primary hypothyroid up (6-40); central hypothyroid low/normal; on levothyroxine 15-30% out of range

name: free_t4
signal: Hypothyroid down (0.4-0.9); over-replacement up

name: wbc
description: White blood cell count (sum of differential)
signal: Inflammation and prednisone up

name: anc
signal: Inflammation and prednisone up

name: alc
signal: Inflammation and prednisone down; untreated adrenal insufficiency slightly up

name: eosinophils
signal: Untreated adrenal insufficiency modestly up (>0.5 in a minority); prednisone down

name: hemoglobin
signal: Inflammation, hypothyroidism and low testosterone (men, ~1 g/dL) down

name: platelets
signal: Inflammation up

name: crp
signal: Inflammation up (8-60); prednisone down

name: cortisol_ordered
description: Cortisol was ordered (presence is itself a signal)
missing: MNAR: ~15% baseline, +70% x adrenal deficit, +30% with hypophysitis, steroid or hydrocortisone

name: cortisol_am
signal: Adrenal insufficiency down; falls with later draw (14:00 ~0.55 x 08:00); on hydrocortisone reflects dose timing; prednisone suppresses and cross-reacts
missing: Blank if not ordered, or if ordered without a draw time
source: Roche Elecsys Cortisol II intervals; Bornstein 2016; Krasowski 2014 BMC Clin Pathol (cross-reactivity)

name: acth
signal: Secondary AI low/inappropriately normal; primary AI high (stays >100 on replacement)
missing: ~85% of ordered cortisols have a paired ACTH

name: cortisol_draw_time
missing: ~20% of ordered cortisols lack a draw time; cortisol then counts as missing

name: phq9
signal: Psychological up (12-24); endocrine and inflammatory deficits mildly up (somatic items)
missing: ~50% present; more often when distress is high

name: gad7
signal: Psychological up; levothyroxine over-replacement up

name: fact_g
description: FACT-G total (core of FACT-M and FACT-ICM)
signal: Lower with any burden; psychological most
missing: Present whenever a QoL instrument is on file

name: fact_m_total
signal: Lower with any burden; psychological most
missing: Present only when the instrument is FACT-M

name: baseline_cog_z
signal: Correlates ~0.75 with current cognitive trait (per-patient baseline)

name: tier3_refused
missing: ~20%; more often older or more distressed patients

name: tier3_draw_time
description: Clock time of Tier 3 blood draw
signal: Afternoon draw lowers testosterone

name: fasting
signal: Non-fasting lowers testosterone ~20-25%

name: igf1
signal: GH deficiency down (age SDS ~N(-1.8,1), overlaps normal); hypothyroidism down

name: lh
normal: M 1.5-9.3; premenopausal F 2-15 (mid-cycle to ~90); postmenopausal F 15-60
signal: Pituitary gonadal deficiency down; testosterone replacement suppresses

name: fsh
signal: Pituitary gonadal deficiency down; postmenopausal pituitary failure <20-25

name: testosterone
description: Total testosterone (men only; blank for women by design)
signal: Sex-hormone cause down (<250); age, prednisone, non-fasting and afternoon draws lower it
source: Travison 2017 J Clin Endocrinol Metab; Bhasin 2018 J Clin Endocrinol Metab

name: estradiol
description: Estradiol (women only; blank for men by design)
signal: Premenopausal sex-hormone cause down

name: il6
signal: Inflammation up (6-30); prednisone down

name: tnf_alpha
signal: Inflammation up (2-6)

name: hvlt_total_recall
signal: Follows cognition factor; falls with age
source: Benedict 1998 Clin Neuropsychol; Wefel 2011 Lancet Oncol (ICCTF battery)

name: tmt_b_seconds
description: Trail Making Test B time (higher = worse)
signal: Rises as cognition factor falls; rises with age

name: cowa_total
signal: Follows cognition factor

name: pcl5
signal: Psychological up
source: Blevins 2015 J Trauma Stress; Weathers 2013 (National Center for PTSD)

name: presenting_complaint
description: Presenting complaint (drawn the same way for every cause)
source: Proposal: all six causes present identically

name: primary_cause
description: Cause with the largest share of symptom burden (6-class label)
normal: thyroid / adrenal / growth_hormone / sex_hormone / inflammatory / psychological

name: secondary_cause
description: Second cause if its share is above 0.25 (else blank)

name: score_thyroid
description: Share of symptom burden from thyroid (six scores sum to 1)

name: score_adrenal
description: Share of symptom burden from adrenal (six scores sum to 1)

name: score_growth_hormone
description: Share of symptom burden from growth hormone (six scores sum to 1)

name: score_sex_hormone
description: Share of symptom burden from sex hormone (six scores sum to 1)

name: score_inflammatory
description: Share of symptom burden from inflammatory (six scores sum to 1)

name: score_psychological
description: Share of symptom burden from psychological (six scores sum to 1)

name: menstrual_phase
description: Premenopausal women: follicular / ovulatory / luteal (explains LH/estradiol spread)

name: dmg_primary_hypothyroid
description: Thyroid gland permanently damaged by thyroiditis

name: dmg_functional_hypogonadism
description: Functional low sex hormones (age, steroids, stress)

name: deficit_thyroid
description: Current deficit 0-1 after replacement (over-replacement scored as 0.2-0.45)

name: deficit_sex
description: Current deficit 0-1 after replacement (x0.2 for postmenopausal pituitary loss)

name: inflammation_factor
description: Latent inflammation (SD units; chronic irAE adds 1.5-3)

name: cognition_factor
description: Latent current cognition (SD units; higher is better)

name: burden_thyroid
description: Raw symptom burden from thyroid (score = burden / total)

name: burden_adrenal
description: Raw symptom burden from adrenal (score = burden / total)

name: burden_growth_hormone
description: Raw symptom burden from growth hormone (score = burden / total)

name: burden_sex_hormone
description: Raw symptom burden from sex hormone (score = burden / total)

name: burden_inflammatory
description: Raw symptom burden from inflammatory (score = burden / total)

name: burden_psychological
description: Raw symptom burden from psychological (score = burden / total)

name: true_cortisol_0800_endogenous
description: Gland cortisol output at 08:00 with no steroid, hydrocortisone, draw-time or assay effect (ug/dL)

name: hc_hours_since_dose
description: Hours since last hydrocortisone dose at the cortisol draw (blank if not on hydrocortisone)

name: true_testosterone_0800_fasting
description: Gland testosterone at 08:00 fasting, before replacement (men, ng/dL)
